// Inert fixture: eval/base64/fetch/spawn used in ordinary, non-malicious ways.
import { spawn } from "node:child_process";

const two = eval("1 + 1");
const avatar = Buffer.from("aGVsbG8gd29ybGQ=", "base64").toString("utf8");
const proc = spawn("git", ["rev-parse", "HEAD"]);

export async function load() {
  const res = await fetch("https://api.example.com/items");
  return { two, avatar, proc, items: await res.json() };
}
